Early treatment with triptans may lead to shorter duration from migraine headache onset to its peak but did not alleviate headache severity at peak. This could result in decreased migraine burden by reducing total migraine headache duration. Furthermore, studies suggest that early treatment and use of triptans may help shorten the time to headache peak and reduce its severity, as well as decrease the overall duration of a migraine episode.

In other words, early intervention with triptans can lead to more efficient pain relief and potentially reduced symptom severity, allowing individuals to manage their migraines better. However, it's essential to note that this finding may not apply universally and should be considered in conjunction with individual patient responses and treatment outcomes.
